core_delta: Introduce ORIGINAL_ANCESTOR -> PERFECTED_ANCESTOR -> CLAY_ONE_MODULE_LOOP_CORE as a three-way matched baseline to separate feedback-law gains from architectural-consolidation gains.
Use event-driven multirate recurrence rather than one global cadence.
Use typed residual/error/uncertainty/resource/stability vectors rather than one global scalar controller.
Continue recurrence only when expected marginal verified-outcome/information gain exceeds compute + instability + opportunity cost and unresolved pressure remains material.
Low state delta with high residual is STALLED and triggers evidence/reseed/reroute/escalation, never successful halt.
Outcome verification precedes durable learning; causal credit is receipt-gated and may be refined by TD/hindsight/counterfactual evidence.
Separate provisional within-episode adaptation from durable post-outcome learning.
Use anti-windup/hysteresis/refractory/rollback controls to prevent oscillation, repeated low-yield activation and runaway coupling.
Use receding-horizon prospection: verify consequential steps and replan from verified state instead of long open-loop execution.

adaptive_recurrence.interpretation: Supports testing marginal-value recurrence under heterogeneous task depth; does not prove Frank benefit.

delta_only_halt.interpretation: Supports explicit residual condition for convergence classification.

clayresearch.delta: Adjudicate the three-way ORIGINAL/PERFECTED/ONE_MODULE baseline and separate improvements caused by feedback closure from improvements caused by module fusion.
clayresearch.required_next_test: Cross-domain metric vector + counterhypothesis matrix for baseline A/B/C under matched episodes/resources.

frank.delta: Map each historical regulator into VERIFIED_ADAPTIVE_RECURRENT_LOOP_CORE_V1 or NO_BENEFIT; preserve lineage while introducing PERFECTED_ANCESTOR as a counterfactual functional upper-baseline.
frank.required_next_test: Typed historical-organ loop map with state variables, timescales, residual targets, gains, effect routes, re-entry and lesion/rescue handles.

gwt.delta: Test GWT as conditional cross-organ compute admission/continuation rather than fixed periodic broadcast; preserve delivery/reconstruction/use/effect receipts.
gwt.required_next_test: Fixed cadence vs event-driven conditional ignition vs local-only handling on matched episodes, including false ignition/missed ignition/resource cost.

emergenz.delta: Add residual-aware regime classification and causal-credit controls while preserving recurrence != emergence.
emergenz.required_next_test: Factorial test of truthful/shuffled/no-reentry x adaptive/fixed recurrence x lesion/rescue, without optimizing an emergence scalar.

claycode.delta: Represent residual vectors, predicted/verified outcome pairs, provisional/durable learning, credit uncertainty, adaptive continuation reasons, hysteresis/refractory/rollback and PERFECTED_ANCESTOR lineage in executable typed IR.
claycode.required_next_test: Compile minimal VerifiedAdaptiveLoopCore contract through parser -> typed IR -> type/effect -> evaluator/runtime on Ubuntu.

hyperposition.delta: Treat preserved alternatives as bounded stalled-regime rescue; branch reopening is controlled exploration, not automatic recurrence.
hyperposition.required_next_test: Stalled replay episodes: reopen vs retrieve-new-evidence vs reroute vs no-rescue, measuring recovery, branch growth and destabilization.

claygraph.delta: Project predicted->verified outcome edges, causal-use/credit edges, loop gain/delay/inhibition, regime transitions and A/B/C baseline lineage as epoch-bound derived topology.
claygraph.required_next_test: Dynamic causal episode projection with stale-edge, shuffled-credit and rollback reconstruction tests.

unifieddb.delta: Persist exact causal episode, residual vector, expected outcome, verified outcome, provisional update, durable admitted update, credit evidence/uncertainty, regime readout and A/B/C replay identity.
unifieddb.required_next_test: Deterministic replay/query contract proving no mixed epochs or duplicate durable learning after restart/out-of-order outcome receipts.

harness.delta: Build matched ORIGINAL_ANCESTOR vs PERFECTED_ANCESTOR vs ONE_MODULE experiment; measure whether adaptive feedback repair or one-module consolidation causes the gain.
harness.required_next_test: Frozen H1 episode suite with fixed/adaptive recurrence, true outcome verification, credit receipts, false-halt/stall/overthinking/recovery metrics; H2/H3 differential afterward.

global_controls: perfect means engineering target, not universal mathematical perfection
successful outcome does not credit every active state
adaptive recurrence must pay compute/resource/instability/opportunity cost
spectral stability is a local diagnostic, not cognitive quality
